verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents an official hosted MCP server (mcp.skyfire.xyz/mcp, sandbox variant) with specific tools (find-sellers, create-kya-token, create-pay-token, create-kya-payment-token) authenticated via API key, letting agents discover sellers and execute commerce workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation beyond first-party docs, and no evidence of broader MCP ecosystem adoption or third-party client testing.
